samples.summary: Column-axis reorder refusal (`moveColumns` / `merge-move-frozen` on frozen columns) has no test
samples.evidence: Every new freeze-vs-reorder test is row-only: `moveRows(5, 2, 2)` at merge.test.ts:924 and :1131-1132, and the backend spec's "refuses a move that would park a merged block across the freeze" uses `axis: 'row'`. `moveCells` and the backend `assertMoveKeepsMergesOffFreeze` both branch on `axis`/`frozenCols`, and `moveColumns` newly returns a boolean, but no test passes `axis: 'column'` with `frozenCols > 0`. Grep of packages/sheets/test for `moveColumns` shows only moving.test.ts and formatting.test.ts, neither with a freeze.
searchedFor: read new merge.test.ts freeze describe block

samples.summary: Single-cell normalization on the spreadsheet-HTML paste path is untested
samples.evidence: `normalizeSingleCellGrid` is applied to both `html2grid(...)` (sheet.ts:2437) and `string2grid(...)` (sheet.ts:2444). The new tests 'should paste an external grid from the anchor too' and 'should not shift a multi-cell external paste off the selected row' only pass `{ text: ... }`; no test passes `{ html }` with `isSpreadsheetHtml` true while the active cell is covered by a merge. A regression on the HTML branch (value written to a covered cell and hidden until unmerge) would ship silently.
searchedFor: read new paste tests in merge.test.ts

samples.summary: `sortFilterByColumn` clearing the copy buffer has no test
samples.evidence: The diff adds `this.clearCopyBuffer()` inside `sortFilterByColumn` with a comment that a sort renumbers snapshotted cells. Tests exist for the insert (merge.test.ts 'should drop the copy buffer when rows are inserted'), the reorder, and undo/redo, but grep of packages/sheets/test for `sortFilterByColumn` returns only filter.test.ts:203/226/260/325, none of which copies first or asserts `getCopyRange()` afterwards. A stale buffer here would let a later paste relocate formulas and re-create merges from wrong coordinates.

samples.summary: View-layer behavior changes (drag-reorder `if (!moved) return`, removal of post-paste `clearCopyBuffer`, `revalidateCopyBuffer` on remote change) have no tests
samples.evidence: worksheet.ts:4661 (skip re-selection when the reorder was refused), worksheet.ts:4947 and spreadsheet.ts:724 (no longer clearing the copy buffer after paste) and worksheet.ts:5248 (`revalidateCopyBuffer` after a remote structural change) are all only covered indirectly by model-level tests (`moveRows` returning false, `revalidateCopyBuffer` called directly in merge.test.ts:1192-1201). The package has a view test lane (test/view/worksheet-mouse.test.ts, worksheet-keymap.test.ts), but grep there for `moveRows|reorder|clearCopyBuffer|paste(` returns no matches, so nothing pins the wiring: e.g. dropping the `revalidateCopyBuffer` call would leave a stale clipboard after a peer's insert with all suites still green.

samples.summary: Spill handling inside `clearCellsUnderMerge` (now newly reachable from paste, incl. `unblockedAnchors`) is untested
samples.evidence: The extracted `clearCellsUnderMerge` deletes ghost cells of a spill anchor, clears spill blockers and feeds `unblockedAnchors` back into the recalculation in `paste` (sheet.ts:2481-2503). Grep of packages/sheets/test for `spillAnchor|spillBlocked` matches only worksheet-grid, data-validation, formatting and style-mutation tests — none involving merges, paste or moveRangeTo. So neither the pre-existing move path nor the newly added paste path has a test where a merged block lands over a spill anchor/ghost; orphaned ghosts or a spill that never re-attempts would ship undetected.

samples.summary: `revalidateCopyBuffer` no-op branch when the copied range has no axis-ID coverage is untested
samples.evidence: `anchorsForRange` returns undefined past axis-ID coverage, and `revalidateCopyBuffer` then returns early (sheet.ts:2260 `if (!buffer?.sourceAnchors) return;`). The only test ('should drop the copy buffer when a peer renumbers the copied rows', merge.test.ts:1171-1203) stands up an `AxisIdStore` whose orders always cover the copied cell, so the fall-through case — a copy outside coverage surviving a remote renumber — is never exercised or documented by a test.
searchedFor: grep getRowOrder in packages/sheets/src and test

samples.summary: Backend `PUT freeze` snap is tested only on the row axis and only for a single non-cascading block
samples.evidence: worksheet.controller.spec.ts:78-86 covers `rows: 2` snapping to 4 with one merge. No backend test covers `cols` snapping (the `snapped.frozenCols` write at worksheet.controller.ts:~118) or the cascade loop through a chain of blocks; the cascade is only covered in the engine (merge.test.ts 'should cascade the freeze snap through a chain of blocks'). A column-axis wiring slip in the controller would not be caught by the backend jest lane.

samples.summary: New refusal message strings for `merge-paste-partial`, `merge-paste-frozen`, `merge-move-frozen` are untested
samples.evidence: `refusalMessage` gains three cases in view/worksheet.ts:107-115. Grep of packages/sheets/test for `refusalMessage` or the message text finds nothing (only autofill.test.ts:220 asserts the refusal *code*). Wrong or duplicated user-facing copy would not be caught, though the model-level tests do pin the codes.
searchedFor: grep refusalMessage|Can't drop onto part|merge-autofill in packages/sheets/test
